integrity: The boundary-zero calculation is reconstructed from local factorization and exact change of variables. The curvature coefficient follows from the conformal image of the counterclockwise unit-circle boundary, and the sign is independently checked on f(z)=z-1. No finite experiment is used as proof. The primary theorem and its boundary half-plane reduction were inspected directly, and related curvature literature was compared at statement level.
scientific_limitations: The refinement is proved for functions holomorphic on a neighborhood of the closed unit disk and uses the real-analytic boundary germ produced by the local conformal coordinate. Only the first geometry-sensitive correction is identified; the displayed remainder is not claimed optimal, and no several-variable analogue is asserted.
title: Boundary curvature is the first nonuniversal coefficient in holomorphic energy asymptotics
